note: 0.6 dev.96 (Osama, 9 November 2026: 'push the Abrams X and B-21 to live'). Two new US cards, first built on the PLA test branch (pla.20 to pla.26). Abrams X (964): a copy of the M1A2 SEP v3 (191) in its specializations; its stats are in abramsx-contract.json. B-21 Raider (965): a copy of the B-2 Spirit (299) in Airborne (5) only, with the B-2's slots; its extra loadouts are in b21-loadout-contract.json. Without the private FAModels mod they look like the SEP v3 and the B-2. Not yet run in a game. dev.101 (Osama, 9 Nov 2026): X-47B (969), a copy of the S-70 Okhotnik made American: US side, Air Naval deck (spec 5), the same costs and bays with US weapons from the F-15EX (2x R-77 -> 2x AIM-120, R-37 -> 1x AIM-120, KAB-500 -> GBU-56, PBK-500U -> AGM-154 JSOW, Kh-59MK2 -> AGM-158 JASSM). Su-57D (970): a copy of the Su-57 with the same stats, for its own model.
